citation_heritage_auc.description: Dense embeddings must recover citation heritage better than random (0.5) and exceed TF-IDF citation-based baseline (0.71-0.74)
citation_heritage_auc.note: All dense variants exceed 0.75 threshold with 95% CI lower bounds > 0.75; dense EXCEEDS TF-IDF citation-based (0.71-0.74). Bootstrap CI validation confirms robustness.

cross_lang_same_branch_sachverhalt.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Sachverhalt (facts) section must exceed 0.2
cross_lang_same_branch_sachverhalt.note: Facts section shows strongest cross-lingual alignment; Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy confirmed. All center_projected variants exceed 0.2 with CI lower bounds > 0.2.

cross_lang_same_branch_dispositiv.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Dispositiv (holdings) section must exceed 0.1
cross_lang_same_branch_dispositiv.note: Holdings section shows moderate cross-lingual alignment. Center_projected variants exceed 0.1 with CI lower bounds > 0.1. Raw embeddings FAIL.

cross_lang_same_branch_erwaegungen.description: Cross-lingual same-branch neighbor rate for Erwaegungen (reasoning) section must exceed 0.1
cross_lang_same_branch_erwaegungen.note: Reasoning section is most language-specific; fundamental limitation confirmed. Center_projected variants below 0.1 threshold (CI includes 0.1 for 64dim but point estimate < 0.1).

jurist_pairwise_preference.description: Dense embeddings must pass jurist pairwise preference adversarial gate
jurist_pairwise_preference.note: FAILS at ALL scales tested (3yr: 0.005, 15yr: 0.288, 19yr: 0.37, 22yr: 0.43, 24yr: 0.35-0.38). Dense embeddings are COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS ONLY, not primary navigation mode. True OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target.

linear_hybrid_results.description: Linear combinations of dense + TF-IDF at 22-year scale
linear_hybrid_results.note: Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates but REMAIN BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.78-0.79). Optimal weight shifts toward TF-IDF dominance at scale.

true_oos_jurist_preference_ceiling.note: No representation achieves factory target under true out-of-sample conditions

v18_coarse_hierarchy.note: Even at 4-label branch level, best purity 0.65 < 0.70 threshold

overall_assessment.tfidf_174k_baseline: FROZEN as production baseline (8 reps, 6/8 PASS adversarial gates on mutated accepted mount; working directory embeddings reproduce original freeze: 8/8 PASS, best JP=0.7345). Production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: JP=0.556 (PASS), LangDom=0.448 (PASS) on current accepted mount.
overall_assessment.dense_embedding_role: COMPLEMENTARY VIEWS ONLY (citation heritage, cross-lingual alignment)
